products.name: Panadol 500 mg film-coated tablets
products.note: Composition checked on the Russian register (Haleon). Panadol Extra, Panadol Cold & Flu and children's Panadol are different products.

products.name: Panadol Extra (Optizorb) tablets
products.note: Composition checked on the UK Haleon page; Panadol Extra is not listed on the Russian register (vidal.ru).

products.name: Panadol Cảm Cúm (Panadol Cold & Flu, Vietnam)
products.note: Vietnamese registration VD-16582-12 (made by Sanofi-Synthelabo Vietnam for GSK/Haleon); source is a pharmacy listing quoting the label. Same amounts on Haleon's Middle East 'Panadol Cold & Flu Day' page (panadol.com/en-me). 'Panadol Cold & Flu' in other countries can contain other ingredients (e.g. night versions with an antihistamine) - check the pack.

products.name: Efferalgan 500 mg effervescent tablets
products.note: Russian register (UPSA). Each tablet contains 412.4 mg sodium - relevant for salt-restricted diets. 'Efferalgan with vitamin C' (330 mg paracetamol + 200 mg ascorbic acid) and codeine versions sold in some countries are different products.

products.name: Hapacol Caplet 500
products.note: DHG Pharma (Vietnam) product page.

products.name: Hapacol 650
products.note: DHG Pharma (Vietnam). 650 mg per tablet is higher than the usual Korean 500 mg tablet - count the daily total.

products.name: Hapacol 650 Extra
products.note: DHG Pharma (Vietnam).

products.name: Hapacol Đau Nhức
products.note: DHG Pharma (Vietnam). Contains an NSAID (ibuprofen) as well as paracetamol.

products.name: Hapacol CS Day
products.note: DHG Pharma (Vietnam), cold product.

products.name: Tylenol Extra Strength caplets
products.note: US label (Kenvue). In China the brand 泰诺 (Tylenol) is mainly a cold combination - see the 泰诺 酚麻美敏片 entry; plain paracetamol there is sold as 泰诺林.

products.name: Nurofen 200 mg tablets
products.note: Russian register (Reckitt). Other Nurofen products (Forte, Plus, Multisymptom, Stopkold) differ in strength or ingredients.

products.name: Advil 200 mg tablets
products.note: US label (Haleon). Advil PM, Advil Cold & Sinus and Advil Dual Action contain other ingredients.

products.name: Aspirin 500 mg tablets (Bayer)
products.note: Russian register (Bayer). Aspirin Cardio (100/300 mg enteric tablets) is for heart prevention; Aspirin-C adds vitamin C.

products.name: Аспирин-С (Aspirin C) effervescent tablets
products.note: Russian register (Bayer Consumer Care).

products.name: Цитрамон П (Citramon P) tablets
products.note: Russian register (Usolye-Sibirsky / Moskhimfarmpreparaty). Other 'Цитрамон' products from other makers or countries may have different amounts - check the pack.

products.name: Анальгин (Analgin) 500 mg tablets
products.note: Generic name used by many manufacturers; checked for Pharmstandard-Leksredstva. Metamizole is not sold in Korea and can rarely cause agranulocytosis. Analgin combination products are different.

products.name: Но-шпа (No-Spa) tablets
products.note: Russian register (Opella/Sanofi): 40 mg drotaverine hydrochloride per tablet; No-Spa forte is 80 mg. No-Spa Duo (40 mg + 500 mg) is a combination with a second analgesic. Antispasmodic; drotaverine is not sold in Korea.

products.name: Пенталгин (Pentalgin) film-coated tablets
products.note: Current Russian formula (Otisipharm). Pentalgin NEO, Pentalgin Mono and older 'Pentalgin' products have different compositions - check the pack.

products.name: Ибуклин (Ibuklin) film-coated tablets
products.note: Russian register (Dr. Reddy's). Ibuklin Junior (prescription in Russia) has the same two ingredients at 100 mg + 125 mg.

products.name: 芬必得 布洛芬缓释胶囊 (Fenbid ibuprofen sustained-release capsules)
products.note: China leaflet (Sino-American Tianjin SmithKline, OTC): 0.3 g per sustained-release capsule; a 0.4 g capsule also exists. 芬必得 is also used for a 0.2 g chewable tablet and a 5% ibuprofen cream.

products.name: Combiflam tablets
products.note: Indian product (Sanofi India); composition from its prescribing information, which is marked for registered medical practitioners. Nepali packs were not checked separately. Combiflam suspension has different amounts.

products.name: ロキソニンS (Loxonin S)
products.note: Japan PMDA (Daiichi Sankyo Healthcare, class 1 OTC). NSAID. Other Loxonin S products add further ingredients. Korean loxoprofen products are prescription-only.

products.name: イブA錠 (EVE A tablets)
products.note: Japan PMDA (SS Pharmaceutical). Pack lists amounts per 2-tablet dose. Apronalide is printed as allylisopropylacetylurea (アリルイソプロピルアセチル尿素), a sedative - drowsiness. EVE A EX has 200 mg ibuprofen per dose.

products.name: バファリンA (Bufferin A)
products.note: Japan PMDA (Lion). Other Bufferin products (Premium, Luna) contain different analgesics.

products.name: ТераФлю от гриппа и простуды (Theraflu Flu & Cold) powder
products.note: Russian register (Haleon). Theraflu in the US and other markets uses different formulas (e.g. with diphenhydramine or dextromethorphan); Theraflu LAR/BRO are throat and rub products.

products.name: ТераФлю Экстра (Theraflu Extra) powder
products.note: Russian register (Haleon), lemon. 'ТераФлю от гриппа и простуды Экстра' (cinnamon-apple) is a separate registration not checked here.

products.name: Колдрекс ХотРем (Coldrex HotRem) powder
products.note: Russian register (STADA), lemon; honey-lemon and blackcurrant versions have the same amounts. Coldrex MaxGripp has 1000 mg paracetamol.

products.name: Колдрекс (Coldrex) tablets
products.note: Russian description (GSK) whose registration has been replaced; the page says the product was renamed Колдро-Икс. Coldrex tablets in other countries may differ.

products.name: Фервекс (Fervex) powder for adults
products.note: Russian register (UPSA); lemon, raspberry and sugar-free versions have the same amounts. Fervex for children has the same ingredients at 280/10/100 mg.

products.name: Ринза (Rinza) tablets
products.note: Russian register (made by Unique Pharmaceutical Laboratories, India). Rinzasip, Rinza Lorsept and RinzaPlus are different products.

products.name: Арбидол (Arbidol)
products.note: Russian register (Otisipharm): 100 mg capsules; also 50 mg tablets, 200 mg 'Arbidol Maximum' and a children's suspension. Antiviral not sold in Korea; no Korean equivalent.

products.name: 新康泰克 复方盐酸伪麻黄碱缓释胶囊 (New Contac 12-hour capsules)
match: 复方盐酸伪麻黄碱缓释胶囊
複方鹽酸偽麻黃鹼緩釋膠囊
products.note: China leaflet (Sino-American Tianjin SmithKline); the database labels this one Rx. Sustained release, 1 capsule every 12 h. Other 新康泰克 products differ: 麻敏维C缓释胶囊 adds vitamin C 75 mg, 氨麻美敏片(II) is a paracetamol combination.

products.name: 白加黑 氨酚伪麻美芬片II / 氨麻苯美片 (day/night tablets)
products.note: China leaflet (Bayer Healthcare Qidong, OTC). The white day tablet has no antihistamine; the black night tablet adds diphenhydramine (drowsy). The 白加黑 name is also used for an aspirin + vitamin C effervescent tablet.

products.name: 泰诺 酚麻美敏片 (Tylenol Cold, China)
products.note: China leaflet (Shanghai Johnson & Johnson, OTC). 泰诺 also sells children's suspension/oral solution at different strengths; 泰诺林 is plain paracetamol.

products.name: 999感冒灵颗粒 (999 Ganmaoling granules)
products.note: China leaflet (China Resources Sanjiu, OTC). Also contains herbal extracts (三叉苦, 金盏银盘, 野菊花, 岗梅, menthol oil). Looks herbal but contains paracetamol and a drowsy antihistamine - do not combine with other cold medicines. 复方感冒灵颗粒 is a different product.

products.name: 快克 复方氨酚烷胺胶囊 (Kuaike capsules)
products.note: China leaflet (Hainan Asia Pharmaceutical, OTC). Also contains artificial bezoar 10 mg (人工牛黄). Amantadine is not in Korean OTC cold medicines. The 快克 name is also used for domperidone (快克啉) and herbal products.

products.name: パブロンゴールドA<錠> (Pabron Gold A tablets)
products.note: Japan PMDA (Taisho). Contains dihydrocodeine (opioid cough suppressant). The granule version パブロンゴールドA<微粒> was not checked.

products.name: Лазолван (Lazolvan) syrup 30 mg/5 ml
products.note: Russian register (A. Nattermann/Sanofi). A 15 mg/5 ml children's syrup, 7.5 mg/ml solution and 75 mg MAX capsules also exist; Lazolvan 30 mg tablets are no longer supplied in Russia. Lazolvan Rhino is a nasal decongestant (tramazoline), not ambroxol. Sold as Mucosolvan in many other countries (not checked).

products.name: Амбробене (Ambrobene) 30 mg tablets
products.note: Russian register (Teva/Merckle). Ambrobene Stoptussin is a different product (butamirate + guaifenesin).

products.name: АЦЦ 200 (ACC 200) effervescent tablets
products.note: Russian register (Sandoz). ACC 100 is 100 mg; granules (100/200/600 mg) and syrup also exist, all acetylcysteine.

products.name: АЦЦ Лонг (ACC Long) 600 mg effervescent tablets
products.note: Russian register (Sandoz). Once-daily dose.

products.name: Бромгексин 8 Берлин-Хеми (Bromhexine 8 Berlin-Chemie)
products.note: Russian register (Berlin-Chemie). Generic 'Бромгексин' from other makers comes as 4 mg or 8 mg.

products.name: Синекод (Sinekod)
products.note: Russian register (Haleon). Syrup 1.5 mg/ml; drops 5 mg/ml (vidal.ru/drugs/sinecod__1576). Dry-cough suppressant not sold in Korea.

products.name: Зиртек (Zyrtec) 10 mg tablets
products.note: Russian register (UCB). Drops are 10 mg/ml. US 'Zyrtec-D' also contains pseudoephedrine.

products.name: Кларитин (Claritin) 10 mg tablets
products.note: Russian description (Bayer); the page says the Russian registration expired on 31.12.2025. US 'Claritin-D' also contains pseudoephedrine.

products.name: Супрастин (Suprastin) 25 mg tablets
products.note: Russian register (EGIS). First-generation antihistamine - drowsy. Suprastinex is a different product (levocetirizine).

products.name: Тавегил (Tavegil) 1 mg tablets
products.note: Russian register (STADA). First-generation antihistamine - drowsy.

products.name: Зодак (Zodak) 10 mg tablets
products.note: Russian register (Opella). Zodak Express is levocetirizine 5 mg; Zodacort is a nasal steroid spray.

products.name: Эриус (Erius) 5 mg tablets
products.note: Russian register (Bayer). Syrup is 0.5 mg/ml.

products.name: Смекта (Smecta) 3 g sachet
products.note: Russian register (Mayoly). Source page is the 3 g oral paste; Vidal also lists the classic powder sachet at 3 g (vidal.ru/drugs/smecta__21502). Smecta Forte (6 g) is not supplied in Russia.

products.name: Имодиум (Imodium) 2 mg capsules
products.note: Russian description (Janssen); the capsule registration is cancelled in Russia, where Imodium Express (2 mg orally disintegrating tablet) is sold. Imodium Plus also contains simethicone 125 mg.

products.name: Энтерофурил (Enterofuril) capsules
products.note: Russian register (Bosnalijek): 100 mg and 200 mg capsules, suspension 200 mg/5 ml. Intestinal antibacterial not sold in Korea.

products.name: Регидрон (Regidron) oral rehydration powder
products.note: Russian register (Valenta), 18.9 g sachet dissolved in 1 litre of water. 'Регидрон Био' is a dietary supplement with a different composition.

products.name: Энтеросгель (Enterosgel) oral paste
products.note: Russian register (Farmasil). Silicon-based adsorbent; no Korean equivalent.

products.name: Гевискон (Gaviscon) original oral suspension
products.note: Russian register (Reckitt). UK 'Gaviscon Peppermint Liquid Relief' and 'Gaviscon Original Aniseed Relief' state the same per 5 ml (250/133.5/80 mg; medicines.org.uk/emc/product/113 and /623). Gaviscon chewable tablets hold half the 10 ml amounts per tablet. Gaviscon Double Action and Advance/Forte are different.

products.name: Гевискон Двойное Действие (Gaviscon Double Action) suspension
products.note: Russian register (Reckitt); 10 ml sachets have the same amounts. Chewable tablets: 250/106.5/187.5 mg. The 'Gaviscon Dual Action' sold in Vietnam and other Asian markets was not checked.

products.name: Gaviscon Advance / Гевискон форте oral suspension
products.note: UK SmPC (Reckitt). The Russian 'Гевискон форте' has the same amounts (vidal.ru/drugs/gaviscon_forte__45332). Contains potassium - caution in kidney disease.

products.name: Ренни (Rennie) chewable tablets
products.note: Russian register (Bayer); orange, menthol and sugar-free mint versions have the same amounts. Rennie-Tal and other Rennie products differ.

products.name: Алмагель (Almagel) suspension
products.note: Russian register (Balkanpharma, Bulgaria). Almagel A also contains benzocaine; Almagel Neo also contains simethicone.

products.name: Маалокс (Maalox) chewable tablets
products.note: Russian register (Opella). Russian Maalox suspensions contain the same two ingredients (e.g. 525 mg + 600 mg per 15 ml sachet). US 'Maalox' products can contain other ingredients.

products.name: Фосфалюгель (Phosphalugel) oral gel
products.note: Russian register (Opella). 20% aluminium phosphate gel: 20 g sachet = 2.48 g aluminium phosphate; 16 g sachet = 2.08 g.

products.name: Эспумизан (Espumisan) 40 mg capsules
products.note: Russian register (Berlin-Chemie). Espumisan L emulsion 40 mg/ml, Espumisan baby 100 mg/ml, Espumisan extra 125 mg granules - all simethicone.

products.name: Мезим форте (Mezim forte) tablets

ingredients.amount: lipase 3,500 U, amylase 4,200 U, protease 250 U

products.note: Russian register (Berlin-Chemie). Mezim 20000 and Mezim neo 10000/25000 are higher-strength pancreatin.

products.name: Фестал (Festal) tablets

ingredients.amount: 192 mg (lipase 6,000 U, amylase 4,500 U, protease 300 U)

products.note: Russian register (Sanofi India). Contains bile components and hemicellulase besides pancreatin.

products.name: Дюфалак (Duphalac) syrup
products.note: Russian register (Abbott).

products.name: Дульколакс (Dulcolax) 5 mg tablets
products.note: Russian register (A. Nattermann/Opella). In other countries 'Dulcolax' is also used for sodium picosulfate drops or docusate softeners.

products.name: 吗丁啉 多潘立酮片 (Motilium) 10 mg
products.note: China leaflet (Xian Janssen), OTC class A in China. Prescription-only in Russia (vidal.ru) and in Korea. Heart-rhythm risk at high doses.

products.name: 达喜 铝碳酸镁咀嚼片 (Talcid) 0.5 g
products.note: China leaflet (Bayer Healthcare); this leaflet version is labelled Rx in the database. Antacid.

products.name: Стрепсилс (Strepsils) honey & lemon lozenges
products.note: Russian register (Reckitt); sugar-free lemon and children's strawberry versions have the same amounts. Strepsils Intensive contains flurbiprofen 8.75 mg (NSAID); Strepsils Express adds lidocaine; other flavours add vitamin C or menthol.

products.name: Фарингосепт (Faringosept) 10 mg lozenges
products.note: Russian register (Sun Pharma / Terapia); all flavours 10 mg. Not sold in Korea.

products.name: Тантум Верде (Tantum Verde) 3 mg lozenges
products.note: Russian register (Angelini). Spray (0.255 mg/dose, forte 0.51 mg/dose) and 0.15% rinse are also benzydamine.

products.name: Лизобакт (Lizobakt) lozenges
products.note: Russian register (Bosnalijek). Lizobakt Komplit spray is a different product.

products.name: Гексорал (Hexoral) 0.1% solution
products.note: Russian register. Gargle, not swallowed. Hexoral Tabs lozenges contain different ingredients.

products.name: Вольтарен Эмульгель (Voltaren Emulgel) 1% gel
products.note: Russian register (Haleon). A 2% Emulgel (12-hour) also exists. Voltaren tablets and injections are prescription products.

products.name: Фастум гель (Fastum gel) 2.5%
products.note: Russian register (Menarini). Ketoprofen gel can cause sun sensitivity - keep the treated skin out of sunlight.

products.name: Бепантен (Bepanthen) 5% ointment / cream
products.note: Russian register (Bayer). Bepanthen Plus also contains chlorhexidine.

products.name: Фенистил гель (Fenistil gel) 0.1%
products.note: Russian register (Haleon). Fenistil drops (1 mg/ml) are oral dimetindene; Fenistil Pencivir is penciclovir cream for cold sores.

products.name: Зовиракс (Zovirax) 5% cream
products.note: Russian register (Haleon). Zovirax Duo-Active also contains hydrocortisone; Zovirax tablets are prescription-only.

products.name: Левомеколь (Levomekol) ointment
products.note: Russian register (Nizhpharm). Antibiotic wound ointment; no Korean OTC equivalent with the same ingredients (Korean topical antibiotics use fusidic acid or mupirocin).
